response.overview: In Paris in 2024, Imane Khelif is catapulted from obscurity into the limelight. The Algerian boxer is the first athlete from Africa to win a gold medal. But her triumph unleashes an unprecedented political and media storm: her status as a woman is challenged, and her body becomes a battleground.  Her strength, her physique, her very existence are as divisive as they are unifying. Torn between her thirst to pursue her passion and her anger at being constantly called into question, Imane then embarks on a new fight, taking on the institutions that prevent her from boxing.
response.title: Imane Khelif: Still Fighting
